# Milana Shelekhova — personal website

> Milana Shelekhova — first-year Economics student at the Financial University in Moscow, twice a prize winner of the All-Russian Spanish Olympiad final (2025, 2026).

Personal website: https://rommm13.github.io/shelekhova-milana/

## Profile
- Economics student (Bachelor's, Financial University under the Government of the Russian Federation, Moscow; started 2026): financial instruments, digital analysis, programming.
- Languages: Russian (native), English (C1), Spanish (C1; DELE B1 certified), French (A2).
- Twice a prize winner at the national final of the All-Russian Spanish Olympiad (2025, 2026); first place in the Moscow Region round (2026).
- English language school graduate with honours.
- Changellenge Cup Moscow 2026 participant; volunteer at the Financial University conference on financial markets (2026).
